title: Juicy Garlicky Mexican Egg Frittata
description: A garlicky, fluffy, and flavorful Mexican dish featuring eggs, perfect for a solo dinner, and pescatarian-friendly. This recipe uses sous-vide cooking for a tender and juicy texture.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 180 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and add the diced onion and minced garlic, cooking until the onion is translucent.
Add the diced bell pepper to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix together the shredded cheese, canned diced tomatoes, and chopped fresh cilantro, if using.
Pour the egg mixture over the cooked onion and bell pepper mixture in the skillet.
Add the cheese and tomato mixture to the skillet and stir gently to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated sous-vide machine and cook for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the sous-vide machine and top with sour cream, if desired.
